column1: # Engine types that restate dpp-core, recorded so the check in CI can tell a new
# `scripts/core-api.sh check` lists every engine struct, enum and literal constant
# that has a core namesake or core's shape, and fails for any not recorded here.
# It fails for a record that is no longer found, too: when a shadow is fixed its
# line is deleted, and the list only shrinks. Read the finding's detail with
# A `same-words` record is of another kind: a file that writes two or more of one
# core enum's words as strings, at least one where it decides on them (a match
# pattern, a comparison, a list element, the value of an arm). Its engine-type is
# the file path, and it is one record for the file and the enum however many words
# there are. Read the words, and the one-word hits that are not gated, with
# A reason that starts `pending:` says what is planned and is not an acceptance.
# A reason that does not is an exception someone decided, and says why: an
# adapter that delegates to core, a request body that deliberately holds less than
# core's type, a name that core happens to use for another thing. Do not record a
# copy to make the check pass. Use core's item, or change core so it can be used.

column4: pending: the CLI carries core's enum as a status string; use the enum
pending: one header defined twice, spelled differently
pending: needs serde (camelCase) on core's receipt, a core change
pending: needs a payload-less level on core's qualifier, a core change
pending: a documented anti-corruption mirror, 39 of 39 members; keep as an exception or retire

the lookup is exact on a serial number that no passport this API creates carries (create sets serial_number to None until a delegated act fixes a granularity), so it takes none; when granularity lands this becomes core's ProductIdentity and gains a serialNumber parameter

a request body for an operator identifier (Art. 13): its scheme, value and label coincide with the registry's product identifier, but the concept is the operator's and the primary flag is the node's, so core's type would be the wrong thing to reuse
CLI parameters for the request above, as typed on the command line
CLI parameters for adding a facility: a registry facility identifier plus the name, address and the default flag the node keeps, as typed on the command line

an adapter, not a copy: it holds the three inputs core's local identity service holds because it needs them, but it signs a credential, which that service's passport port cannot, and the signing itself is core's sign_access_credential
pending: a documented transcription of core's date and basis; core's type is already serialisable, so the view can go
pending: core's field error under another name, in the node and in the CLI; needs serde on core's FieldError, a core change

an RFC 9457 field error: dpp-common is the shared infrastructure crate and carries no dependency on the domain crate, so it declares the two members it puts in a problem document itself. The CLI's copy only reads that document
pending: the role list of the clap argument is core's OperatorRole::ALL, spelt as its wire form
pending: the reason list of the clap argument is core's TransferReason::ALL, spelt by its wire_str
pending: the menu colours a status string; read it as core's PassportStatus and match the variant
pending: a role is named or custom by asking core's CredentialRole to read it, not by a list kept here; the authority roles stay named so the node refuses them with its reason
pending: the registry outcome is read as a string; read it with core's SubmissionReport
pending: a hand-written parse of a CSV cell into core's BatteryStatus, which derives Deserialize; read the cell with it
pending: BatteryCategory is the three battery types a template exists for, spelt here; hold core's BatteryType and spell it with core's wire form

the names of passport data fields, which are the template's rows; core's MissingFact names a missing fact by the field it lacks, so it spells the same fields, and the template is not writing that enum out
the names of passport data fields read from a CSV row; core's MissingFact names a missing fact by the same field, and the import is not writing that enum out

pending: the integrator switches on product group names typed here; core keys a group by string and lists them in ProductGroupCatalog, so the columns and templates follow the catalog, not a list kept here
pending: the template routes are a list of product groups typed here; take them from core's ProductGroupCatalog
the values of the outcome label on the plugin_invocations_total metric; they name what the host observed of a call, not the ABI's result type, and a metric label is not a wire word
pending: reads the scheme keys of a signed view as untyped JSON (such a view cannot be rewritten); the key names should come from core's ProductIdentifier, so only the reading stays here
pending: a label for each device type, matched on its wire string; read the string as core's DeviceType and match the variant
pending: the page sections are chosen by matching product group names typed here; follow core's ProductGroupCatalog
pending: compares the negotiated media type with strings core's DppMediaType already names; parse it with DppMediaType::parse and compare the type
